culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: The Kosrae State Historic Preservation Office asks visitors to show respect by asking permission before visiting a site or beach. Its visitor guidance describes Sunday as a day of rest and asks visitors to respect no work, including hiking and diving. Ask local hosts what is appropriate and how to arrange a visit.
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Kosrae State Historic Preservation Office and relevant local landholders or hosts

sources.title: Visiting Kosrae & Kosraean Culture
sources.supports: the office's own guidance on requesting permission and Sunday rest, read directly

culture-and-protocol.note: This is the state preservation office's visitor guidance. Local permissions and site rules still need to be confirmed with the people responsible.
